Stock Market Crashes❗️

The Union Health Ministry confirmed two cases of Human Meta Pneumo Virus (HMPV) in Karnataka. 

Stock market investors opted for caution, leading to a drop of over 1,200 points in the Sensex and a decline of approximately 1.4% in the Nifty. https://t.co/xTmxChUVqG
